description: Fork of exp001 (vanilla MinimalGPT GPT-2 baseline, 23M params, b=8 -> 1.6256) with device_batch_size 8 -> 32. Pair with exp270 (b=16). Tests whether the b=8 -> b=32 lever that gained ~0.16 bpb on the hybrid LUT model (exp265 -> exp267) is LUT-specific. If vanilla also gains ~0.16, the effect is generic; if vanilla gains << that, the LUT-specific sparse-Adam-statistics hypothesis is confirmed.
